description: Source code for the TransformFeedback class and related functions in the ANGLE graphics library, managing transform feedback state and operations.

classes.name: TransformFeedback
classes.description: Manages transform feedback operations, state, and buffers within the ANGLE graphics library.

classes.name: TransformFeedbackState
classes.description: Holds the internal state of a TransformFeedback object, including buffers, primitive mode, and counters.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts transform feedback with specified primitive mode and program, calculating buffer capacity.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends transform feedback, releasing resources and resetting state.

methods.name: onVerticesDrawn
methods.description: Updates internal counters after drawing vertices.

methods.name: bindProgram
methods.description: Binds a program to the transform feedback object.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from transform feedback by buffer ID.

methods.name: bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a specific index with offset and size.

methods.name: checkBufferSpaceForDraw
methods.description: Checks if there is enough buffer space for a draw call.
